This type represents the explicit junction row in mall_platform_shipment_items. It exposes the row identity, the linked shipment, the linked order item, and the timestamps used for audit, browsing, and historical review.

Use this shape when returning shipment contents from shipment detail endpoints. It is intentionally narrow and does not include any computed totals, ordering metadata, or duplicate foreign-key columns.
IMallPlatformShipmentItem.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Map directly to mall_platform_shipment_items as a shipment-item membership summary. Expose the junction row id and timestamps directly from the table. Expose shipment by joining the shipment relation to mall_platform_shipments and orderItem by joining the orderItem relation to mall_platform_order_items, both as summary DTO references. Exclude the raw foreign-key columns mall_platform_shipment_id and mall_platform_order_item_id because the relation objects already represent those associations in the public contract. Do not add computed counts, ordering metadata, or other derived fields because this junction table stores only membership and audit timestamps.

id.description:
The shipment's unique identifier.

This value identifies the shipment record referenced by tracking and detail endpoints.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from mall_platform_shipments.id. Expose the UUID primary key as the shipment identifier.

carrierName.description:
The shipping carrier name.

This identifies the carrier responsible for transporting the package.
carrierName.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from mall_platform_shipments.carrier_name. Expose the shipment carrier name exactly as stored.

trackingNumber.description:
The shipment tracking number.

This number is used to follow the package with the carrier.
trackingNumber.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from mall_platform_shipments.tracking_number. Expose the carrier-issued tracking number for the shipment.

trackingUrl.description:
The optional carrier tracking URL.

When present, this opens the carrier's tracking page for the shipment.
trackingUrl.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from mall_platform_shipments.tracking_url. Preserve null when no tracking URL is stored; otherwise expose the stored URL string.

status.description:
The current shipment status.

This indicates the package's delivery progress, such as preparing, shipped, delivered, or cancelled.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from mall_platform_shipments.status. Expose the shipment status exactly as stored in the database.

shippedAt.description:
The time the shipment was handed to the carrier.

This value is null until the package has been dispatched.
shippedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from mall_platform_shipments.shipped_at. Preserve null until the shipment is handed to the carrier; otherwise expose the stored timestamp.

deliveredAt.description:
The time the shipment was confirmed delivered.

This value is null until the package reaches delivered status.
deliveredAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from mall_platform_shipments.delivered_at. Preserve null until delivery is confirmed; otherwise expose the stored timestamp.

seller.description:
The seller responsible for this shipment.

This is shown as a seller summary so clients can display the merchant context for the package.
seller.x-autobe-specification: Join mall_platform_shipments.mall_platform_seller_id to mall_platform_sellers.id and return IMallPlatformSeller.ISummary as the seller summary relation. This is a read-side relation mapping, not the raw foreign key column.

order.description:
The order associated with this shipment.

This is shown as an order summary so clients can display which purchase the package belongs to.
order.x-autobe-specification: Join mall_platform_shipments.mall_platform_order_id to mall_platform_orders.id and return IMallPlatformOrder.ISummary as the order summary relation. This is a read-side relation mapping, not the raw foreign key column.

createdAt.description:
The time the shipment record was created.

This timestamp helps consumers identify when the shipment entry was first recorded.
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from mall_platform_shipments.created_at. Expose the creation timestamp in ISO date-time format.

updatedAt.description:
The time the shipment record was last updated.

This timestamp reflects the most recent change to the shipment record.
updatedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from mall_platform_shipments.updated_at. Expose the last update timestamp in ISO date-time format.

deletedAt.description:
The time the shipment was soft-deleted.

This value is null for active shipments and populated only for logically removed records.
deletedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from mall_platform_shipments.deleted_at. Preserve null for active shipments and expose the stored soft-delete timestamp when logically removed.

IMallPlatformShipment.IInvert.description:
Shipment tracking details for one delivery package.

This schema represents the read-only shipment view used by customer, seller, and administrator tracking endpoints. It includes the shipment's core tracking fields, lifecycle timestamps, and linked seller and order summaries needed to display package-level tracking information.

The response is intentionally shipment-level rather than item-level. Item membership is excluded because every item in the shipment shares the same carrier and tracking data, and the item list is exposed elsewhere.
IMallPlatformShipment.IInvert.x-autobe-specification: Map this read DTO directly from mall_platform_shipments as the shipment tracking/detail view. Expose scalar shipment fields as direct mappings from their snake_case columns. Expose seller and order as read-side relation summaries joined from mall_platform_seller_id → mall_platform_sellers.id and mall_platform_order_id → mall_platform_orders.id. Keep all nullable database fields nullable in the DTO and preserve ISO date-time formatting for timestamp fields. Do not include shipmentItems because this DTO is shipment-level tracking data, not item membership data.

orderItemIds.description:
The order items to include in the forced refund.

Provide zero or more order item UUIDs to narrow the administrator action to selected items within the target order. If omitted, the system applies the forced refund to all eligible items.

The server verifies ownership and eligibility for each listed item before executing the refund.
orderItemIds.x-autobe-specification: Optional array of order item UUIDs to include in the forced refund for the order identified by the path parameter. When present, each UUID must be validated against the target order and forced-refund eligibility before any state changes occur. When absent, the service applies the refund to all eligible items in the order. Do not persist this field; it is request-only input.

IMallPlatformOrder.IForceRefund.description:
Administrator command payload for selecting the scope of a forced refund.

Use this body to limit the administrator action to specific order items within the target order. If orderItemIds is omitted, the forced refund applies to all eligible items in that order.

This payload is execution input only. The server resolves the order identity from the path, validates eligibility, and records any required snapshots during processing.
IMallPlatformOrder.IForceRefund.x-autobe-specification: This schema is the request body for the administrator force-refund operation on a specific order. The optional orderItemIds array narrows the refund to specific order items within the order identified by the path parameter; if omitted, the service must apply the forced refund to all eligible items in that order. The payload is not persisted and does not map to a database column or relation; it exists only to instruct validation and execution of the refund workflow, including item ownership checks and eligibility checks before any mutation occurs.

IMallPlatformAdministratorApprovalReques.description:
An update payload for recording the final review decision on an administrator approval request.

This payload is used by an authorized super administrator to approve or reject a pending request. It includes only the fields that may change during review and does not expose the applicant's original reason or identity.

If the request is rejected, a rejection reason should be provided. If the request is approved, the rejection reason is typically omitted or null. Reviewer metadata and the review timestamp may be stored by the backend as part of the same update transaction.
IMallPlatformAdministratorApprovalReques.x-autobe-specification: Maps the mutable review fields for an administrator approval request. The backend should apply this payload only to pending requests and preserve the applicant reason and identity. Reviewer metadata and review timestamp may be recorded during the same transaction when available.

id.description:
The unique identifier of this cancellation request snapshot.

This value identifies one immutable historical record and is used to reference the snapshot in API responses and related lookups.

snapshotStatus.description:
The cancellation request status preserved when this snapshot was recorded.

This reflects the request state at the historical moment captured by the snapshot, not the current live request state.

reviewResult.description:
The reviewer outcome preserved in this snapshot, if one was recorded.

This field shows the decision or result associated with the request at the time of capture and may be absent when the request had not yet been reviewed.
reviewResult.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from mall_platform_cancellation_request_snapshots.review_result. Nullable in the database, so the DTO allows null.

reason.description:
The cancellation reason or reviewer note preserved in this snapshot, if available.

This text captures the reason that was recorded when the snapshot was created and is retained for audit and dispute review.
reason.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from mall_platform_cancellation_request_snapshots.reason. Nullable in the database, so the DTO allows null.

changedAt.description:
The business time when the captured cancellation request state became effective.

This timestamp marks when the preserved state represented by the snapshot should be considered active in the business timeline.

createdAt.description:
The time when this snapshot record was created.

This is the storage creation timestamp for the immutable history entry.

updatedAt.description:
The time when this snapshot record was last updated in storage.

This is an audit timestamp for the immutable record and indicates the most recent persistence update, if any.

deletedAt.description:
The soft-delete timestamp for this snapshot record, if one exists.

Snapshot rows are normally retained permanently, so this field is expected to remain null in standard operation.
deletedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from mall_platform_cancellation_request_snapshots.deleted_at. Nullable in the database, so the DTO allows null.

cancellationRequest.description:
The cancellation request that this snapshot belongs to.

This nested summary reference lets consumers inspect the live cancellation request associated with the preserved historical snapshot.
cancellationRequest.x-autobe-specification: Resolve the belonged relation from mall_platform_cancellation_request_snapshots.cancellationRequest to mall_platform_cancellation_requests and expose it as IMallPlatformCancellationRequest.ISummary.

IMallPlatformCancellationRequestSnapshot.description:
Immutable cancellation request snapshot history entry.

This summary represents one preserved point-in-time state of a cancellation request, including the stored status, reviewer outcome, reason text, linked cancellation request, and audit timestamps. It is intended for historical review and dispute resolution and reflects the request exactly as it was recorded when the snapshot was created.
IMallPlatformCancellationRequestSnapshot.x-autobe-specification: Read-only summary DTO for immutable cancellation request snapshots. Map the snapshot table columns directly to the DTO properties id, snapshotStatus, reviewResult, reason, changedAt, createdAt, updatedAt, and deletedAt. Map the belonged cancellationRequest relation to IMallPlatformCancellationRequest.ISummary, resolved from mall_platform_cancellation_request_id. The raw foreign key column is intentionally excluded because the consumer-facing representation is the nested cancellation request summary. This DTO is used for historical review and dispute resolution and must preserve the immutable snapshot state exactly as stored.

mall_platform_customer_id.description:
Identifier of the customer account to recover.

Provide the UUID of the customer account that should receive a password reset record. The server uses this value to create the recovery entry and associate it with the matching customer account.
mall_platform_customer_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to mall_platform_customer_password_resets.mall_platform_customer_id. This UUID identifies the customer account that will receive the password reset record. The server uses it to create and associate the recovery entry; no nested customer object is accepted in this request body.

IMallPlatformCustomerPasswordReset.ICrea.description:
Password reset initiation payload for a customer account.

This request identifies the customer account that should receive a password reset record. The server creates the recovery entry and manages the token, expiration, usage state, and audit timestamps internally.
IMallPlatformCustomerPasswordReset.ICrea.x-autobe-specification: This DTO creates a customer password reset record in mall_platform_customer_password_resets. The client supplies only the customer account UUID via mall_platform_customer_id. The server uses that value to create the reset row, generate the secure token, compute expired_at, initialize used_at as null, and manage created_at, updated_at, and deleted_at internally. The customer relation is derived from mall_platform_customer_id and is not sent as a nested object in the request body.

scope.description:
Selects whether the administrator cancels the whole order or only specific order items.

Use wholeOrder to apply the intervention to every eligible item on the order referenced by the URL path. Use selectedItems to cancel only the order items listed in orderItemIds.
scope.x-autobe-specification: Use this field to choose the scope of the administrator force-cancel action for the order identified by the URL path. wholeOrder means cancel every eligible item in the referenced order. selectedItems means cancel only the order items listed in orderItemIds after verifying each item belongs to the target order and is eligible for cancellation. This value is not persisted to mall_platform_orders and has no database mapping.

orderItemIds.description:
The order item UUIDs to cancel when only selected items are targeted.

This field is used only when scope is selectedItems and must contain UUIDs for order items that belong to the order in the URL path.
orderItemIds.x-autobe-specification: Provide the UUIDs of the order items to cancel when scope is selectedItems. Each UUID must reference an order item that belongs to the order identified by the URL path and is eligible for administrative cancellation. The list must contain unique UUIDs and is ignored when scope is wholeOrder. This value is not persisted to mall_platform_orders and has no database mapping.

IMallPlatformOrder.ICreate.description:
Administrator intervention payload for forcibly cancelling an existing order.

Use this request body with the administrator force-cancel endpoint to choose whether the cancellation applies to the entire order or only selected order items. The order itself is identified by the URL path, so this body only carries cancellation scope and item-selection input.
IMallPlatformOrder.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: This schema is the administrator-only request body for the force-cancel order endpoint. It does not create or update a mall_platform_orders row. The URL path supplies the target orderId; this body supplies cancellation control input only. scope selects whether the operation applies to the entire referenced order or only to a chosen subset of its items. orderItemIds is used only when scope is selectedItems and must contain UUIDs for items that belong to the target order and are eligible for administrative cancellation. Both fields are request-time control values and map to no persisted order columns or relations.

decision.description:
The approval or rejection decision for the cancellation request.

Set this field to indicate how the pending request should be resolved. The server uses the value to update the request and record the final outcome.
decision.x-autobe-specification: Interpret this field as the approve/reject command for the cancellation decision workflow. The service layer combines it with the route parameters and authenticated reviewer to finalize the request, update persisted state, and write the immutable snapshot. Because the stored record uses status and review metadata instead of a decision column, this field has no direct database mapping.

reviewerNote.description:
An optional note from the reviewer.

Use this to explain the approval or rejection decision, add context, or leave a short internal comment. It may be omitted when no note is needed.
reviewerNote.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to mall_platform_cancellation_requests.reviewer_note. Persist the note when provided; store null when omitted. This field is optional and is used only as supporting context for the reviewer’s decision.

IMallPlatformCancellationRequest.IDecisi.description:
Cancellation request decision payload.

Use this body to approve or reject a pending cancellation request for a specific order item, and optionally attach a reviewer note. The route identifies the request target while authentication identifies the acting reviewer.
IMallPlatformCancellationRequest.IDecisi.x-autobe-specification: This request body carries only the user-entered inputs needed to decide a pending cancellation request. The decision field is a workflow command consumed by the service layer to approve or reject the target request; it does not map to a stored column and instead drives server-side updates to status, review_result, reviewed_at, reviewer_id, and snapshot history. The reviewerNote field maps directly to the persisted reviewer_note column and should be stored as the reviewer’s optional explanatory note. Route parameters and authentication context supply the order-item scope and reviewer identity, so they must not appear in this DTO.

IMallPlatformSellerProfile.ISummary.description:
A compact seller profile summary.

This object represents the current public shop profile for one seller account. It is used in browsing, seller profile pages, and snapshot-related references, and includes the seller account relation together with the shop name, shop description, logo image URI, and lifecycle timestamps.

The summary contains only the live profile state stored in the database. Historical edits are preserved separately in seller profile snapshots and are not included here.
IMallPlatformSellerProfile.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Map directly from mall_platform_seller_profiles. Expose id, shop_name, shop_description, logo_image_uri, created_at, updated_at, and deleted_at from the row. Resolve seller_account_id through the sellerAccount relation and expose it as IMallPlatformSellerAccount.ISummary. Do not include sellerProfileSnapshots in this summary view.

IMallPlatformCancellationRequest.ISummar.description:
A summary view of a cancellation request for one order item.

This object represents the current live state of a cancellation request, including the requested reason, review outcome, reviewer note, and lifecycle timestamps. It is used for scoped retrieval and list views where consumers need the active request state without the full immutable snapshot history.
IMallPlatformCancellationRequest.ISummar.x-autobe-specification: Map id, reason, status, reviewed_at, review_result, reviewer_note, created_at, updated_at, and deleted_at directly from mall_platform_cancellation_requests. Resolve mall_platform_cancellation_requests.mall_platform_order_item_id to orderItem as IMallPlatformOrderItem.ISummary. Resolve mall_platform_cancellation_requests.reviewer_id to reviewer as IMallPlatformAdministrator.ISummary when present, otherwise null. Do not expose raw foreign-key scalar properties or the snapshots collection in the summary DTO.
